name: Bryan
source:
Handsome, charming, friendly, and utterly useless at his job. Has a huge crush on the grumpy librarian, and spends his time at the library when he isn’t napping at work.

[From [url=https://jaimescribblesgames.com/2018/01/19/as-we-know-it/]Jaime Scribbles Games[/url]]
